accuracy = max(accuracies, default=60)
    intervals = calendar + repeat
    if not intervals:
        return None, None
    overall = max(intervals) + accuracy

evidence.reason: The timer-bound calculation only adds AccuracySec to the largest OnCalendar/repeat interval; RandomizedDelaySec is never parsed or added. Because systemd adds that random delay to each activation, a timer declaring it can fire later than the returned bound, so preflight admission can be unsound. This is an ordinary correctness fix in the existing bound calculation, not a new contract requirement.
